suppress.notes: angus-activation is the Jakarta Activation implementation, not Angus Mail; the CPE match lands on eclipse:angus_mail. CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection in the mail library, and this service sends no SMTP at all (account mail goes through Resend's HTTP API).

micrometer-registry-prometheus is the client-side metrics exposition library; the CPE match lands on prometheus:prometheus, the Prometheus SERVER (CVE-2026-42154 targets the server's /api/v1/read endpoint, which this library neither contains nor exposes).

hibernate-validator (Jakarta Bean Validation) matches the generic validator:validator CPE, which belongs to the Nu Html Checker (validator.nu) web service - a different product (CVE-2025-15104 is an SSRF in that checker's URL fetching).
